note: Notice source registry (N5). Every emit site carries `// notice: <id>`; the id is registered here with its trigger, its destination (action), whether it sounds, and where the user switches it off. switch "none" is called out by the Supervisor.

page-download-saved.area: page: toastManager.js 'melaton:download' saved (a file the Android app saved for her): WM notification on the phone, in-page toast on the desktop / DeX
page-download-saved.action: Open (window.AndroidNotification.openDownload: the only way from here to the saved file)
page-download-saved.switch: phone: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Other notifications > Display message on screen; desktop / DeX: none (it only follows her own Save)
page-download-saved.note: #1321: replaces the app's Android download notification. Silent. One at a time, the newest replaces it (N9).

page-download-failed.area: page: toastManager.js 'melaton:download' failed, her Save did not happen
page-download-failed.action: none: the notice is the failure in words
page-download-failed.sound: by the toast policy: the desktop message box is silent; the phone's Errors event (its Sounds & Notifications setting)
page-download-failed.switch: phone: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Errors; desktop / DeX: none
page-download-failed.note: #1321: replaces the app's Android 'Save failed' notification. An error that stopped her own action, told once per download id (N6, N10).

page-download-open-failed.area: page: toastManager.js, Open on a saved download opened nothing
page-download-open-failed.action: none: the notice is the failure in words
page-download-open-failed.sound: by the toast policy: the desktop message box is silent; the phone's Errors event
page-download-open-failed.switch: phone: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Errors; desktop / DeX: none
page-download-open-failed.note: #1321. Only after her own tap on Open.
